title: A Japan tour playbill with names that won't appear
summary: Carter jokes about an upcoming Japan tour announcement listing musicians he cannot afford.

story.theme_name: Going abroad: American jazz musicians touring and living in Europe
story.community_name: Going abroad: touring Europe and Japan

blocks.x: But speaking of things that didn't take place, or I mean, that were billed and don't take place, I'm just gonna give you an example of just something that happened quite recently, and it could take place, but in all probability, it won't, and it has to do with my upcoming tour of Japan.

And the promoter of this tour came to me; I just signed the contract yesterday, but about 3 days ago, I saw him out in Los Angeles, and he showed me the bill, which I shall show to you later. The announcement, and the announcement had names of musicians that I have no idea that they're going to be with me -- it's a dream group; I'd love to have them -- you know what I mean, but I know I'm not going to be able to afford it, and I assured him of this, you know, that the budget I'm working with, and he said, 'Oh ..' -- I mean this is a printed Playbill type of

thing, you know. He said, "Oh, that's all right. When you get the members together, we make another one with the right members!" You know, but when this falls in to the hands of someone years later, they'll say, "See? So and so was in Japan with Benny Carter."
It's nice of them to say they'll put out thepne with the people that you really intend to play with. Because sometimes they never even do that, you know.
They get several months ahead of us, you know. That's right.
